title: Developing confidence training coaching
quote: I attended a session yesterday on behalf of Clifford Chance mentoring scheme where Martin did a session on virtual networking and virtual interviews. I loved his session as he improved my skills in video interviews, for example, my speed of speaking was really fast. The session was really interactive and would love to attend events in the future organised by Martin and would love to have Martin as my career coach.
author: Asil Ahmad
subject: Mentoring
